# Contact us

### Vote.je

**Telephone:** [01534 441020](tel:1534441020)

**Email:** [contact@vote.je](mailto:contact@vote.je)

**Address:** Morier House, Halkett Place, St Helier, JE1 1DD.

**Opening Hours:** Monday to Thursday 9.00am to 5.00pm and Friday 9.00am to 4.30pm

Vote.je is managed by the States Greffe.

### **Jersey Electoral Authority (JEA)**

The Jersey Electoral Authority acts as a politically neutral and independent arbiter of the electoral process. The remit also includes addressing the conduct of candidates and overseeing their election expenditure.

The JEA was established in 2022 in response to recommendations within the Commonwealth Parliamentary Association Electoral Observer’s Mission Report, published after the 2018 election.

To contact the JEA, please email [admin@jea.je.](mailto:admin@jea.je)
